questions.q: What does Snowflake email you after you sign up at trial.snowflake.com?
options: A downloadable desktop installer
A permanent API key with no expiration
Nothing — you must call support to get access
A unique account URL along with the username and password you set during signup
questions.explain: Registration sends a unique account URL plus the credentials you created, which you use to sign in for the first time.

questions.q: What does a brand-new trial account already have, before you create anything yourself?
options: Nothing at all — you must create a role, warehouse, and database before running any query
A default role (ACCOUNTADMIN) and a default warehouse (COMPUTE_WH), but no database selected yet
A pre-loaded production dataset with millions of rows
Every warehouse size already created and running
questions.explain: A fresh account ships with ACCOUNTADMIN and COMPUTE_WH already available, but CURRENT_DATABASE() returns NULL until you create or select one.

questions.q: What does INITIALLY_SUSPENDED = TRUE do when creating a warehouse?
options: Prevents the warehouse from ever being resumed
Creates the warehouse in a suspended state so it doesn't start consuming credits immediately
Forces the warehouse to run at maximum size
Deletes the warehouse after one query
questions.explain: INITIALLY_SUSPENDED = TRUE means the new warehouse starts suspended rather than running, avoiding unnecessary credit usage before it's actually needed.

questions.q: In the lab's first-query sequence, what confirms that architecture, hierarchy, and warehouses are all working together correctly?
options: The CREATE DATABASE command by itself, with no further steps
Successfully signing in to Snowsight
Seeing COMPUTE_WH listed under Admin > Warehouses
SELECT * FROM first_table returns the one row you inserted
questions.explain: Getting your inserted row back from SELECT * FROM first_table confirms the full path worked: your warehouse ran the query, against your database/schema/table, and returned the correct data.

questions.q: Why create your own LAB_WH warehouse instead of just using the default COMPUTE_WH for the lab exercise?
options: Creating a second warehouse is required before any database can be created
Trial accounts are not allowed to use COMPUTE_WH
COMPUTE_WH cannot run any SQL queries
It ties together Lesson 4's warehouse-configuration concepts (size, auto suspend, auto resume) by having you set them yourself
questions.explain: Creating LAB_WH yourself, with explicit size and auto-suspend/auto-resume settings, reinforces the warehouse concepts from Lesson 4 hands-on rather than just relying on the account's pre-existing default.
